decisions.quote: Discussion Summary of Replication Attempt The original effect failed to replicate. There was no significant difference in intolerance to inequality between participants in the economic inequality (M = 5.79, 95% CI [5.39,6.19]) and height inequality condition (M = 5.63, 95% CI [5.19,6.06], t(116) = -0.55, p = .58, d = 0.10, 95% CI [-0.76,0.43]).
decisions.location: PRIMARY PROJECT REPORT: garciacastro2020.html, Discussion: Summary of Replication Attempt (line 538); also raw_data.csv row garciacastro2020 (line 279)
decisions.reason: Both the primary replication report (garciacastro2020.html) and raw_data.csv confirm a failed replication of García-Castro et al. (2020) Study 3a. Although the manipulation check showed a significant difference in perceived wealth disparity, both substantive hypotheses—the main effect of the perceived economic inequality manipulation on intolerance of inequality (t(116) = -0.55, p = .58) and the mediation of support for redistribution by intolerance of inequality (ACME = 0.15, p = .52)—failed to replicate, and both instructor and report subjective replication codes in raw_data.csv are 0. Both shipped and blind coded 'failed', but blind omitted an outcome quote; shipped_right is recorded with a verbatim primary quote.
